# TalkType 0.3.2
- Simplify the menu bar popover to the mascot and app name, microphone status, Settings, and Quit. - Keep voice typing available through the configured hold shortcut, with update checks and floating companion controls in Settings. - Preview speech in the floating companion while the shortcut is held, then insert the complete formatted transcript into the focused text field after the shortcut is released.
Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later. This free preview uses a persistent local signing certificate and is not Apple notarized. macOS may ask you to allow it in Privacy & Security after downloading.

# TalkType 0.3.1
- Keep incoming speech previews in order so an older recognition update cannot replace newer words in the floating companion. - Preserve the smooth one-line transcript scrolling introduced in 0.3.0.
Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later. This free preview uses a persistent local signing certificate and is not Apple notarized. macOS may ask you to allow it in Privacy & Security after downloading.

# TalkType 0.3.0
The first public preview of TalkType, a small macOS menu bar companion for voice typing.
- Hold the chosen shortcut to dictate into the focused text field. Words appear as recognition arrives. - The floating companion follows the latest word smoothly on one line and can be dragged anywhere. - Choose from seven soft themes, adjust the transcript size, and control mascot motion and sound cues. - The welcome guide covers permissions and shortcut setup. Settings includes Sparkle update controls.
Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later. This free preview uses a persistent local signing certificate and is not Apple notarized. macOS may ask you to allow it in Privacy & Security after downloading.
